widget.doc: One article tile for a blog grid: PostCard kind="skyline" tone="day" tag="Infrastructure" title="..." excerpt="..." author="Priya Raman" initials="PR" meta="Mar 12 · 9 min read" onPressed={open="..."} (a drawn cover from kind and tone, default day; a tap fires onPressed with the title).

props.doc: The cover scene, as Media: skyline, market, festival, train (a city); harbor, lagoon, dunes (water); mountain, forest, temple, bamboo (hills).
The cover's time of day: dawn, day, dusk or night.
The category, as a small pill (empty: none).

props.default: What we learned moving 40 services to one queue
props.doc: The article's title (two lines at most).
One line of what it is about (empty: none).
The author's initials, in the round plate.
The date and reading time, under the name.
What to mark in the title and the excerpt (a search query: what fuzzy matched is drawn bold and underlined; empty: nothing).

events.doc: The tile was tapped; the value is the title.

props.excerpt: Six brokers, one partitioned log, 60 percent fewer pages.
